meta.title: With partial awarding off, a second vendor cannot be added to a line already fully awarded
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup recipe does not specify that QA vendor 2, specifically, already holds the full award.
The library case uses an over-quantity award request rather than an award request with no stated quantity based on the vendor's quoted 30 units.
The plan cannot independently set or verify that partial awarding is off; it relies on the library case precondition.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot select bid with more than requested quantity.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: With partial awarding off, a second vendor cannot be added to a line already fully awarded

expected.message: You cannot select bid with more than requested quantity.
